notes.title: Sayouri Update
notes.notes:
Before you get all excited, be sure to update also any DLC's you might have lying around - otherwise weird things might happen!

Ok, with that out of the way - here it is. Long awaited Sayouri update. Enjoy!

Sayouri puzzles are demanding. If you worked hard on your ability build and found a great OP strategy - there is a challenge for you now, a real one. 

However if you just want to skip the gameplay part, remember there is always the secret combination of keys: 1 + 2 during gameplay finishes the puzzle.

notes.title: Early X-mas Update and Plans
notes.notes:
An early Xmas update has hit the store. So this is one of those things that usually annoy us - like Christmas hits being played too early. But we are working on Point Shop Items that should be unleashed early next month and we want to squeeze some X-mas content in there. Since you cannot update the Point Shop Items once you are online (not without a good reason at least) - we need to squeeze that one puzzle early.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015258/c11b6eff9d9f666914912f3c9f91b5f4418bc5e0.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015258/d43cbcd709c5d964cf8ea20668730c55ba88aacf.jpg

So that's that for that 1 extra puzzle. So what can we expect from Cards the Point Shop Items?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015258/76be293dacc393f3f40e28264fa6456ec0bd34a2.png

 there will be backgrounds, stickers (never before seen in the "Neko Waifus" franchise), and avatars, We should have just about everything and in large quantities. Stuff is still in the works so if you have something you would like to see - type it in the comments, maybe we will still manage to do it somehow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015258/8dfc61a7c97814db491696381fa9393a4ba3aa02.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015258/1b75ad82492ab203bbc521de0071b77966dbbbdb.gif

Also the usual "Clips DLC" - hopefully, that will be done just in time for the Autumn Sale.

Cheers!
